# RI$E Finance

> RI$E Finance is a financial literacy platform for young people in Pakistan, offering interactive learning modules, an AI tutor, and practical money-management challenges.

## Pages
- [Home](https://risefinance.money/): Overview of the platform and what it offers
- [About](https://risefinance.money/about): Mission and background
- [Research](https://risefinance.money/research): Research on financial literacy among Pakistani youth
